title: meriandra dianthera
intro:
Meriandra dianthera, commonly known as 'Wild Jasmine' or 'Himalayan Jasmine', is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Meriandra dianthera include its anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-spasmodic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: More research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of Meriandra dianthera.
